text: asc (rorkai/App-Store-Connect-CLI) is an MIT-licensed, unofficial Go CLI: asc validate, submit, asc review status/doctor, asc status --watch; authenticates with key-id, issuer-id and private key, with --bypass-keychain for headless CI. It states it is not affiliated with Apple. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-02)
keywords: App Store Connect API and CLI automation of submission and review

text: Review submission via API is a three-step flow: POST /v1/reviewSubmissions (app + platform), POST /v1/reviewSubmissionItems linking the app version, then PATCH the submission with submitted=true. Order matters; out-of-order calls give 422/foreign-key errors. (medium confidence)
keywords: App Store Connect API and CLI automation of submission and review

text: API keys come in two types: Team keys (all apps, role-based, created by an Admin) and Individual keys (inherit one user's apps and roles). Individual keys cannot use Provisioning endpoints, Sales and Finance, or notaryTool. The private .p8 downloads once only; never commit it. (high confidence)
keywords: App Store Connect API and CLI automation of submission and review

text: fastlane recommends a Team key (required for provisioning-related API access); credentials are key_id, issuer_id and the .p8 content, JWT duration max 1200 seconds. fastlane produce has only partial API-key support, pem is Apple ID only, precheck cannot check IAPs with API keys. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-02)
keywords: App Store Connect API and CLI automation of submission and review

text: Apple rejects JWTs with lifetime over 20 minutes for most requests; responses carry an X-Rate-Limit header with an hourly rolling limit, so throttle polling and back off. (medium confidence)
keywords: App Store Connect API and CLI automation of submission and review
